questions.question: Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. (16, 60, 240)
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(16, 60, 240)
questions.solution:
The Logic here is as follows:

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4 = 3rd number

In (16, 60, 240)

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4

= (16 × 60) ÷ 4

= 960 ÷ 4

= 240 = 3rd Number

Now check the all options,

Option (1) (20, 12, 121)

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4

= (20 × 12) ÷ 4

= 240 ÷ 4

= 60 ≠ 3rd Number

Option (2) (16, 38, 260)

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4

= (16 × 38) ÷ 4

= 608 ÷ 4

= 152 ≠ 3rd Number

Option (3) (14, 42, 196)

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4

= (14 × 42) ÷ 4

= 588 ÷ 4

= 147 ≠ 3rd Number

Option (4) (18, 56, 252)

(1st number × 2nd number) ÷ 4

= (18 × 56) ÷ 4

= 1008 ÷ 4

= 252 = 3rd Number

Hence, the correct answer is "(18, 56, 252)".

Option 1: 900

Option 2: 845

⇒ Sum of digits of 845 = 8 + 4 + 5 = 17

Option 3: 825

⇒ Sum of digits of 825 = 8 + 2 + 5 = 15

Option 4: 840

⇒ Sum of digits of 840 = 8 + 4 + 0 = 12

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

1008 : 8 :: ? : 6 :: 220 : 4
questions.solution:
Given: 1008 : 8 :: ? : 6 :: 220 : 4

The logic followed here is:

1008 : 8 → (8 + 2)3 + 8 = 103 + 8 = 1000 + 8 = 1008

220 : 4 → (4 + 2)3 + 4 = 63 + 4 = 216 + 4 = 220

Similarly,

? : 6 → (6 + 2)3 + 6 = 83 + 6 = 512 + 6 = 518

Hence, 518 is the correct answer.

(22, 64, 352)

Similarly,

Option 2 → (14, 68, 238) → 14 × 17 = 238

68 × 3 + (68/2) = 238

9 : 50
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

(1st number + 1)2 / 2 = 2nd number

For 9 : 50 

(9 + 1)2 / 2 = 102 / 2 = 100 / 2 = 50

Similarly, 

13 : 98 

(13 + 1)2 / 2 = 142 / 2 = 196 / 2 = 98

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Alternate Method

Given: 9 : 50

The logic followed here is: by multiplying the first number with the closest number to the get the second number as shown below,

9 : 50 → 9 × 5 + 5 = 45 + 5 = 50

By checking options,

(1) 5 : 16 → 5 × 3 + 3 = 15 + 3 = 18 ≠ 16

(2) 13 : 98 → 13 × 7 + 7 = 91 + 7 = 98

(3) 8 : 42 → 8 × 5 + 5 = 40 + 5 = 45 ≠ 42

(4) 11 : 63 → 11 × 5 + 5 = 55 + 5 = 60 ≠ 63

Hence, 13 : 98 is the correct answer.

15 : 135 :: 16 : ? :: 18 : 189
questions.solution:
Given: 15 : 135 :: 16 : ? :: 18 : 189

The logic follows here is:

15 : 135 → [(15 + 3) × 15] ÷ 2 = [18 × 15] ÷ 2 = 9 × 15 = 135

18 : 189 → [(18 + 3) × 18] ÷ 2 = 21 × 9 = 189

Similarly,

16 : ? → [(16 + 3) × 16] ÷ 2 = 19 × 8 = 152

⇒ ? = 152

Hence, 152 is the correct answer.
